messages.content: Ask one question at a time and end with HOME CARE, REFER TO CLINIC, or EMERGENCY.
Bachay ko 4 din se bukhar hai aur pani kam pee raha hai.
REFER TO CLINIC: Bukhar 4 din se hai aur pani kam peena dehydration ka risk dikhata hai.
Respond in Hausa and keep the verdict format strict.
Jariri yana amai kuma baya shan ruwa.
EMERGENCY: Jaririn baya shan ruwa kuma yana amai, a kai asibiti nan da nan.
Describe visible signs and give one action.
Kidonda kinaonekana kuvimba na kutoa usaha.
REFER TO CLINIC: Kuna dalili za maambukizi zinazoonekana, mgonjwa apelekwe kliniki leo.
